nothing may follow run/end, not even an event this projection does not read
a committed story never begins again

an outcome stays pending, the story RUNNING, until story/end
one decision per attempt
an outcome needs an open attempt
no story begins once disposal has started (§18)

an abandoned run is final
a first interrupt never abandons, even during disposal
a second interrupt abandons (§20.2)

an admission names only criteria of the frozen plan
